app.title: CosmΩracle — cosmological distance calculator
app.summary: A person picks a preset parameter set, edits any of its values in the sidebar, and types a target value of the independent variable. The interface integrates the model from zero up to that value and reports each derived quantity at the target, rounded to a chosen number of significant digits. The person then ticks which quantities to plot against the variable, sizing each plot and switching to a log scale if they want, with more quantities in a separate expander. Finally they download each plot as a PDF and the whole computed table as a named comma-separated text file. A separate page sets out the definition and equation of every parameter and quantity.

task.text: Compute the standard distance measures and associated quantities for a chosen model at a given redshift, plot them over redshift, and export the table.

data.text: A small set of model parameters, either from a named preset or typed in, and a table of derived quantities computed on an evenly spaced grid from zero to a chosen redshift.
data.item: one redshift sample with its computed distances, volume and lookback time

stage.text: computing reference quantities for an assumed model during analysis

mechanism.text: Sidebar fields hold the model parameters, and filling in the redshift triggers a recomputation that fills a text readout of results. Checkboxes choose which computed curves a configurable line chart draws, and download buttons save the plots and the full table.

field.text: distance measures in background cosmology, in astrophysics

workflow.name: compute derived quantities from model parameters, plot them and export the table

steps.here: pick a named parameter set from a dropdown, which pre-fills the Hubble constant, the matter, dark energy and radiation densities, and w0/wa, all of which stay editable

steps.step: compute a value from the data
steps.here: typing a redshift integrates E(z) on 300 points from 0 to that value, then reports the comoving, transverse comoving, luminosity and angular diameter distances, plus the comoving volume, the lookback time and the physical size of 1 arcsec, rounded to the chosen significant digits
tick any of the four distance measures to overlay them as line styles on one chart against redshift, with width/height sliders and a semi-log toggle

steps.step: look over every item at a glance
steps.here: a 'Click for more plots' expander plots the comoving volume and the lookback time over redshift, each with its own size and log controls
'Download plot' saves each chart as a PDF; at the bottom, the person names a file and downloads every quantity at every redshift as comma-separated text with unit headers
a Documentation page gives the definition and LaTeX equation for each parameter, each distance measure and each associated quantity

distinctive: named preset parameter sets are read from a YAML file and pre-fill the form, but every parameter can still be overridden by hand
curvature is derived from the density parameters, and it chooses the open, flat or closed formula for the transverse distance and the volume
the dark energy equation of state evolves with a w0–wa parametrisation, not as a fixed constant
a derived conversion reports how many kiloparsecs one arcsecond spans at the target redshift
every output carries fixed units (Mpc, Gpc³, Gyr), and the exported table's header names each column with its unit

parts.title: Cosmological parameters sidebar
parts.summary: Lets the person choose a preset parameter set, edit the redshift and model parameters, and set how many significant digits to show.

parts.title: Results
parts.summary: Computes every distance measure and associated quantity at the entered redshift and states each one in a sentence with its unit.

parts.title: Distance measures plot
parts.summary: Overlays the ticked distance measures against redshift, with adjustable size, an optional semi-log scale and a PDF download.

parts.title: More plots expander
parts.summary: Plots the comoving volume and the lookback time against redshift, each with its own size and log controls and a PDF download.

parts.title: Download calculated data
parts.summary: Writes every computed quantity at every redshift to a comma-separated text file with unit headers and lets the person name and download it.

parts.title: Definitions of quantities
parts.summary: Shows the definition and equation for each parameter, distance measure and associated quantity, read from markdown and equation files.
